Made by D.S. Makaroff. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

With reference to the attached communication from the
Netherlands Consulate-General, dated November 11, 1935, on
the subject of Mrs. N. D. Feigen and Mrs. Greenhouse,
enquiries show that:
1) Mrs. Nadejda Davidovna Feigen, Russian, was born on
October 18, 1898, at Goldingen, Latvia. In 1924 she
came to Shanghai from Germany accompanied by her husband
Mr. A. Feigen whom she later divorced. Following the
divorce she became a paramour of E. A. Hotimsky, a gold
bar broker by occupation, with whom she cohabited until
he got married to a certain Rosentour-Minkoff. For the
last six years, Mrs. Feigen has worked for Mme. Greenhouse
as representative of her "salon-de-modes" and also as
outport sales agent. In connection with this work, she
undertook numerous trips to Hongkong, Macao and various
places in China.
2) Mrs. Lea Shita Elisabeth Zalmanoff nee Greenhouse, Polish
Jewess, was born on October 7, 1900 at Vilno, Poland. She
came to Shanghai sometime in 1924 and soon afterwards
married one A. Levenspiel, a Russian Jew, who was considered
a man of doubtful reputation with strong socialistic
tendencies. She divorced him in February 1930, and
married Anatoly A. Zalmanoff, Russian Jew, a merchant,
who at that time was working as a musician.
Mrs. Zalmanoff is a very wealthy woman and is
proprietress of a Dressmaking & Millinery Store at No.790
Bubbling Well Road, and also of the "Femina" Silk Store,
No. 940 B'Well Rd.
There is nothing detrimental known to this office

日期 1935年11月27日。
事由：荷兰总领事馆关于 N.D. 费根夫人和 Greenhouse 夫人的来函。
由 D.S. 马卡罗夫（Makaroff）撰写。由 **〔此处转录不清〕** 转发

参照所附荷兰总领事馆1935年11月11日关于
N. D. 费根夫人和 Greenhouse 夫人的来函，经查询显示：
1) 纳杰日达·达维多芙娜·费根（Nadejda Davidovna Feigen）夫人，俄罗斯人，1898年10月18日出生于拉脱维亚戈尔丁根（Goldingen）。1924年，她由丈夫 A. 费根先生陪同从德国来到上海，后与其离婚。离婚后，她成为金条经纪人 E. A. Hotimsky 的情妇，并与之同居，直到该男子与一位名为 Rosentour-Minkoff 的女子结婚。在过去六年中，费根夫人为 Greenhouse 夫人工作，担任其“时装沙龙”的代表及外埠销售代理。因工作关系，她曾多次前往香港、澳门及中国各地。
2) 莉亚·希塔·伊丽莎白·扎尔马诺夫（Lea Shita Elisabeth Zalmanoff）夫人，婚前姓 Greenhouse，波兰犹太裔，1900年10月7日出生于波兰维尔诺（Vilno）。她于1924年间某时来到上海，不久后嫁给一名名为 A. Levenspiel 的俄罗斯犹太人，此人声誉不佳，且有强烈的社会主义倾向。她于1930年2月与其离婚，随后嫁给了阿纳托利·A·扎尔马诺夫（Anatoly A. Zalmanoff），一名俄罗斯犹太商人，当时以音乐家为业。
扎尔马诺夫夫人非常富有，是静安寺路790号一家服装及帽饰店的店主，同时也是静安寺路940号“Femina”丝绸店的店主。
本局未掌握任何不利信息

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3688.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P[OLICE]
S. B. REGIS[TER]
: B. D._______

SHANGHAI, 11th November 1935.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I have received an
application for a visé for admission into the Netherlands Indies
from Mrs. Nadia Davidovna Feigen, born at Goldingen (Latvia),
18 October 1898, divorced wife of Mr. Feigen, a former Russian
subject.

Mrs. Feigen intends to proceed to Java as representative of
Madame Greenhouse (Me Vacheron), who has a milliner's shop at
790 Bubbling Well Road and who desires Mrs. Feigen to visit her
business relations in Singapore, Batavia, Semarang and Soerabaia,
holding herself responsible for all the expenses of Mrs. Feigen's
trip.

Mrs. Feigen holds at present a passport issued by the local
Bureau of Public Safety on May 10th 1935 (No. 10834) which is
only good for travelling in China and which I advised her to change
for one for travelling abroad. Her private address is at Bubbling
Well Road 778, Denis Apt. 54.

I should be much obliged to you if you would let me know
whether anything is known against her or Mrs. Greenhouse from
a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

S2, For report please.
〔签名〕
12 NOV. 1935

Ds. Makanoff.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

编号 3688。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特科登记簿
: B. D._______

上海，1935年11月11日。

先生：

谨通知阁下，我已收到纳迪娅·达维多芙娜·费根夫人申请进入荷属东印度群岛的签证申请。费根夫人出生于拉脱维亚戈尔丁根（Goldingen），1898年10月18日生，系前俄国臣民费根先生的离异妻子。

费根夫人拟作为 Greenhouse 夫人（即 Vacheron 女士）的代表前往爪哇。Greenhouse 夫人在静安寺路790号拥有一家帽饰店，希望费根夫人拜访其在新加坡、巴达维亚、三宝垄和泗水的商业关系人，并承诺承担费根夫人此次旅行的所有费用。

费根夫人目前持有本地公共安全局于1935年5月10日签发的护照（编号10834），该护照仅适用于在中国境内旅行，我已建议她更换为适用于出国旅行的护照。她的私人住址是静安寺路778号，Denis 公寓54室。

如蒙告知是否有关于她或 Greenhouse 夫人的政治或道德方面的不良记录，我将不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
〔签名〕
中文秘书。

T. P. 吉文斯 先生，
副督察（特科），
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

S2，请出具报告。
〔签名〕
1935年11月12日

Ds. 马卡罗夫。
